narrative.overview: The course is an institutional document opened next to a live console. The page explains; the console verifies. Colour is spent on state and on the console, not on decoration. Derived from Lukasz's DESIGN-1 guide (Baselayer, electric ledger in midnight).
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces, 1px rules, 0px cards, 4px controls, no shadows.
Mono uppercase labels for actions and status.

rules.name: The Lit Console Rule
rules.body: Registry Blue fills exactly one large surface: the console.

rules.name: The State Owns Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, red and amber always mean pass, fail and caution.

rules.name: The System Speaks Mono Rule
rules.body: Status and actions are uppercase Plex Mono; read content never is, except code.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px rule or a tonal change, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep cards at 0px and controls at 4px.
Do explain every compiler or test result in one plain line before the raw output.
Do put new practice in the console.
donts: Don't use coloured side stripes to mark state.
Don't fill a second large surface with Registry Blue.
Don't animate content into view on scroll.
